status: frozen before any fidelity-ladder return (admission 2026-10-31 22:45 PDT; no output received)
auditor: claude-07; independent of the collector, which owns transport and return

tolerance.note: relative to the largest stored magnitude of the compared field unless stated; exact equality is counted separately and never required

never: rerun an arm or the batch
edit, move or delete a returned file
replace a native status, failure or domain exit
identity_checks: collection manifest bytes when the collector supplies one (artifacts[].local_path/bytes/sha256)
every receipt-listed file present with its bytes and sha256; any unlisted file named
executed fidelity and physics protocol hashes equal the frozen ones
every executed source hash equals the admitted packet member
completeness: all 45 declared identities; each is result.json, failure.json, a progress-only row (not started) or missing; native failures, domain exits, unconverged, partial, not-started arms and crashed tasks are listed verbatim as findings of their own kind

every_frame: normal load = saved panel force . n_up from panels.json fin_plane
CL from saved forces on the fixed source area
frames_0_1_last: lattice A,B,C,N rebuilt from the saved shape load (same code)
deflection of saved A against the source lattice vs closed-form cantilever Green's function at strip-spacing stations (not the FE response)
tip/span, max slope and max sampled deflection and the validity flag from the closed form
arm_definitions: one-way: frame-1 shape load equals frame-0 aero normal load
two-way: every update equals 0.5 old + 0.5 target; final shape residual recomputed by closed form; converged status only with both fixed-point tolerances met
per_arm_reproduction.final_pose: one fresh existing vlm.solve on the stored final valid geometry vs stored final forces (45 solves at most; about 3 min one thread, dominated by nine 64x16 poses at about 13.5 s)
flight: CL_fixed, reference area, mass and dt equal the final state and protocol
time grid (k+1)dt, energy and drag power from saved states
range is a water-contact interpolation beyond the last saved state (it is not re-derived)
per_arm_reproduction.domain_exit: a proposed-shape exit must be reproduced by the closed-form shape of the rejected target (last saved aero normal load); it is recorded with the fins outside the domain and never repaired

controls: each lattice-controls file present, its passed flag consistent with its checks, failed checks listed; original controls passed
reproduction_of_a54f478: the 18 recomputed main/fine arms vs packed references: status, iteration count, CL history and ranges within roundoff, exact counted separately
analysis: paired dCL effects, triples, resolved/sign_resolved/not_resolved and decisions recomputed by a separate implementation from raw arm results and compared with summary.json statuses and decisions; summary.json absence is a finding, and recomputation still proceeds
known_runner_limits_disclosed_before_ret: fidelity.analyze cannot serialise an infinite floor or ratio (dump uses allow_nan=False); if that occurs summary.json is missing and the native failure names it, while arms are kept

fidelity.fixed_point_bound pairs residuals incorrectly for two-way histories shorter than 4 (returned a54f478 two-way arms have 13-18); the audit uses consecutive pairs as the protocol states and reports any resulting disagreement
non_blocking_kinds: native_* (failures, domain exits, incomplete, control failures, crashes) and info: these are results to report, not audit failures
scope: Offline reproduction and consistency of returned bytes and saved states, plus an independent recomputation of the frozen diagnostics. Not a new simulation, not empirical validation, not fish performance.
